plan.summary: BRO-5000 owner decision 2026-10-11: four returning shows keep their earlier run separate (inheritReviews false). The other eight links stay on the automatic rule (carry until 5 outlets re-review).
steps: 11 outlets reviewed the 2026 West End run itself, so it has its own critic base. The 2022 Gielgud run stays on its own entry.
35 outlets reviewed the 2026 Adelphi return, so it has its own critic base. The 2025 run stays on its own entry.
13 outlets reviewed the St. Ann's run, so it has its own critic base. The Skirball run stays on its own entry.
The one-part version is a re-staged, shortened show, not the two-part production reviewed from 2016, so its reviews are not carried over.
